profile.headline: Start-up junkie. Team leader. Architecture aficionado.
profile.summary: I do free software, C, Rust, Python, Java, distributed systems, backend code, top to bottom.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Reality Defender detects deepfakes and AI-generated content for enterprises, platforms, and governments.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the incubation team. Working primarily in green field projects, e.g. providing customer inside visibility to SSC core business.

node.js, typescript, microservices, AWS

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Led the third party integrations team, which fed our CASM tool with 20+ integrations with several different security tools. 

AWS, Python.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Led efforts to architect, design and implement a new log storage solution. Zero downtime data migration design and implementation.

Elasticsearch, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
Led planning, designing, and developing the EDR cloud solution for USM Anywhere.

Java, AWS Kinesis, AWS Lambda, AWS Firehose.

positions.title: Senior R&D engineer, Team lead
positions.description: Distribution team lead, in charge of most of the devops tasks. Focus on system updates and distribution tasks (i.e. Debian packaging and distribution, and OS image generation, using Packer and VMware), and the new API design, written in Python, to migrate from a previous in-house Perl solution.

positions.title: Freelance Linux Developer
positions.description:
(The only) Senior developer of a HD video streaming solution in C, under GNU/Linux. I created an adaptive bitrate HD video streaming server, using the FFmpeg suite. I also wrote a video indexer to identify the key frames for each video, encoded in a different bitrate.

C, MySQL.

positions.title: R&D developer
positions.description: Python developer under GNU/Linux. I wrote a tool that identifies and deletes "garbage" files from a 3D rendering video cluster.

certifications.name: Java Application Performance and Memory Management
certifications.title: Java Application Performance and Memory Management
